dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like me to go get Alyosha?

dialogues.speaker: Aksakov
dialogues.text: No, no! Anything but that. Have you ever seen anyone kidnap an old man with a hunting net?

dialogues.speaker: Aksakov
dialogues.text: Dragged me all the way here just because he insisted I might live a few days longer...
